tei:div.tei:p: All thank Thee, all praise Thee, all say: None is holy like the Lord. All exalt Thee, Selah, Creator of all, God who opens daily the portals of the Eastern gates and throws open windows of the firmament, brings forth the sun from its place and the moon from the site of its dwelling. He illuminates the whole world and its inhabitants whom He created through the attribute of mercy. He illuminates the earth and those who dwell on it with mercy, and in His goodness renews daily and constantly the work of creation. O King, who alone is exalted from of old, extolled and praised and glorified since days of antiquity. O God of eternity, in Thy great mercy have mercy upon us, Lord of our might, Rock of our fortress, shield of our salvation, a fortress around us. None can be compared with Thee, there is none except Thee, none beside Thee and who resembles Thee? None can be compared with Thee, O Lord our God, in this world and there is none except Thee, our King, in the life of the future world. There will be nought besides Thee, our Redeemer, in the days of the anointed one and none resembles Thee, our Helper, at the revival of the dead.
